title: TONSTAD / TONSTAD table and 6 chairs
description: TONSTAD / TONSTAD table and 6 chairs, brown oak effect/Fridtuna light beige brown oak effect, 783/4x331/2" TONSTAD dining series introduces fixed or extendable tables in off-white or brushed oak veneer, with softly rounded features that add warmth and elegance. The chairs come with a padded seat or fully upholstered with interchangeable covers.
features: Combines with other products in the TONSTAD series.
A bit screwdriver is required to assemble this table, sold separately as a part of TRIXIG 15-piece toolset.
To prevent surface scratches, complete with TRIXIG stick-on floor protectors, sold separately.
Extra covers for TONSTAD chair are sold separately.
